goal: Implement pros private Gitea release runtime for end-user case folder initialization
assumptions: Gitea server git.leadt3ch.com remains available and accessible
Private npm package registry is configured on Gitea
End users have Node.js/npm installed on Windows
Gitea API tokens can be generated with read access to packages and releases
The source repo .agents/skills/pro-select-* skills are ready for distribution
Windows users can run PowerShell commands
ZIP extraction is handled by the CLI, not OS tools

alternativesConsidered.approach: A: Private npm package with bundled resources
alternativesConsidered.cons: Package size grows with every skill update, no versioned rollback

alternativesConsidered.approach: B: Private CLI + Gitea Release artifacts
alternativesConsidered.pros: Versioned artifacts, checksum verification, curated runtime, rollback support
alternativesConsidered.cons: More complex release pipeline, two auth channels

giteaReleaseApi.response: List of releases with tag names and asset URLs

tasks.title: Implement runtime projection builder
tasks.description: Create script/tool to build dist/runtime/ from source repo with explicit allowlist
acceptanceCriteria: Includes AGENTS.md template with PROS markers

tasks.title: Implement manifest generation
tasks.description: Generate pros-manifest.json with version, file list, SHA256 hashes, provenance metadata
acceptanceCriteria: Manifest includes all runtime files with SHA256

tasks.title: Create Gitea release workflow
tasks.description: Add .gitea/workflows/release.yaml for building and publishing runtime artifacts

tasks.title: Implement pros auth commands
tasks.description: Add auth status and token set commands for Gitea authentication
acceptanceCriteria: pros auth status checks both npm registry and release API
pros auth token set stores token securely (not in case folder)
Token is never logged or written to case artifacts

tasks.title: Rewrite pros init for Gitea releases
tasks.description: Update pros init to download runtime from private Gitea release instead of local copy
acceptanceCriteria: Downloads latest stable pros-v* release by default

tasks.title: Implement pros update with atomic install
tasks.description: Add update command with staging, backup, rollback support

tasks.title: Implement pros doctor
tasks.description: Add diagnostic command with support-friendly categories
acceptanceCriteria: Reports support categories: safe_to_continue, needs_auth, needs_update, repair_needed, contact_support

tasks.title: Add Windows hidden attribute support
acceptanceCriteria: Warns but doesn't fail if attribute can't be set

tasks.title: Generate AGENTS.md bootstrap
tasks.description: Create AGENTS.md template with PROS managed blocks

tasks.title: Add comprehensive tests
tasks.description: Test all new commands and edge cases
acceptanceCriteria: Tests for init with mocked Gitea API
Tests verify no oma-config.yaml in runtime

risks: Gitea API may return 404 for unauthorized private packages (need clear error handling)
Windows ZIP extraction may fail for long paths or locked files
Token management UX may be confusing for non-developer staff
Runtime projection allowlist may miss files or include wrong files
